boundary_four.text: {batter} plays a magnificent cover drive! It races away across the turf and beats the fielder to the ropes for four.
Short and punished! {batter} swivels on the back foot and pulls it powerfully to the square leg boundary for a cracking four.
A juicy full toss from {bowler} and {batter} doesn't miss out! Smacked straight down the ground, beating the man at long-on for four.
Thick outside edge! It flies past the diving slip fielder and races down to the vacant third man region for four lucky runs.
Delicate touch! {batter} opens the face of the bat at the last moment and guides it fine past the keeper for a boundary.
Powerful sweep shot! {batter} gets down on one knee and slog sweeps it hard through mid-wicket, one bounce and over the rope for four.
Driven on the up! {batter} punches it through the gap at extra cover, the fielder gives chase but the ball wins the race.
Beautifully timed straight drive! {bowler} can only watch as the ball races past him to the long-off boundary for a classic four.
Carved through point! {batter} makes room and slashes hard, the ball rockets through the infield and hits the fence in a flash.
Flicked off the pads with elegance! {batter} uses his wrists beautifully to send the ball racing to the fine leg boundary for four.
Width offered and width taken! {batter} throws his hands at a wide one outside off and it screams through backward point for four.
That's been dispatched! {bowler} strays onto the pads and {batter} whips it away through mid-wicket with disdain. Four runs.
Reverse sweep! {batter} gets into an unorthodox position and paddles it past short third man. Inventive shot, four runs.
Back of a length and {batter} rocks onto the back foot, punching it through the covers with authority. The outfielder can only wave at it.
Pitched up and {batter} leans into a gorgeous on-drive. Bisects mid-on and mid-wicket perfectly, that's four all the way.
Inside edge and it runs away fine! {batter} was trying to work it square but gets a fortunate boundary through the vacant leg side.
Short and sat up nicely! {batter} was waiting for that, rolls the wrists on a pull shot that races to deep mid-wicket for four.
Ramp shot! {batter} goes down early and helps it over the keeper's head. Unorthodox but effective, and it reaches the boundary.
Length ball on the stumps and {batter} lofts it cleanly over the bowler's head. Not enough to clear the rope but it bounces into the fence. Four.
Drops it short and {batter} is all over it! A fierce cut shot that bisects point and gully and rattles the advertising boards.
Tossed up by {bowler} and {batter} goes after it! Lovely use of the feet, gets to the pitch and drills it through extra cover for four.
Late cut played expertly! {batter} waits, waits, and at the last instant rolls the wrists to steer it past gully. Class shot, four runs.
Overpitched and punished! {batter} barely has to move his feet, just presents the full face of the bat and times it to perfection through mid-off.
Creamed off the front foot! {batter} gets forward and absolutely middles it through the covers. That is pure timing, races away for four.
Uppish but safe! {batter} drives on the up, it flies between mid-off and the bowler, neither can react in time. Four more.
Down the track to {bowler} and lofted over mid-off for four! Beautifully struck.
Short and wide from {bowler}, and {batter} cuts it away square for four.
Swept fine and it races away to the boundary. Four to {batter}.
Slog-swept over midwicket, one bounce into the rope. Four more.
Reverse-swept! Wide of short third and away for four. Audacious from {batter}.
Driven inside-out over cover, one bounce over the rope. Wonderful shot.
Dropped short by {bowler} and pulled hard into the leg side. Four.
Given the charge and clubbed straight past the bowler for four.
Worked off the pads, beats the man at square leg, and it's four.
Threaded between cover and point. {batter} found the one gap available. Four.
Edge — and it flies past the slips down to third man for four.
Punched off the back foot through extra cover. Four, and that was pure timing.
Clipped off the toes through midwicket. The fielder doesn't move. Four.
Full, and driven straight back past {bowler}. Four all the way down the ground.
Half-volley, and {batter} leans into the drive. Four through mid-off.
Pure timing! {batter} leans into a classical cover drive off {bowler}. The ball whispers across the turf for four.
Crunched off the back foot! {bowler} drops short and {batter} nails the square cut backward of point for four.
Stands tall and punches it straight past {bowler}'s outstretched hands. Blazes down the ground for four!
Upper-cut! {bowler} bangs it in short, {batter} arches the back and ramps it over slip down to the boundary for four!
Disdainful pull shot! Fast delivery picked up early and deposited into the deep square leg boundary for four.
Slower delivery read like a book by {batter}! Waited on it and swung it through wide mid-on for a cracking boundary.
Overpitched outside off, {batter} drives on the up and finds the gap between mid-off and cover for four!
Full on the pads, flicked with wrists of steel! Rents the deep mid-wicket fence for a glorious boundary.
Thick outside edge flies between second slip and gully, racing down to the third man rope for four lucky runs.
Short and wide from {bowler}, slapped with authority over backward point for a one-bounce four!
Pitched up on off stump, {batter} presents the full face and punches it straight as an arrow for four!
Inside edge whistles past the leg stump! Becomes a boundary down to fine leg, agonizing for {bowler}.
Lofted inside-out over extra cover! Gorgeous stroke against {bowler}'s spin, bounces into the boundary cushions for four.
Swept with tremendous authority! {batter} gets down on one knee and hammers it to deep backward square for four.
Reverse sweep executed to perfection! Flashed past backward point, leaving the infielders stranded. Four!
Too short from {bowler}, {batter} rocks back and cuts it crisply backward of point for a boundary.
Dances down the track and chips {bowler} neatly over mid-on, bouncing four times before crossing the boundary rope.
Paddle sweep fine as a hair! {batter} uses {bowler}'s pace and turn, trickling over the rope at fine leg for four.
Drifting in, {batter} makes room outside leg and punches through extra cover for a sensational boundary.
Full toss dispatched with disdain! Smashed straight down the ground past the umpire for four easy runs.
Drilled through the gap at extra cover! The sweeper gave chase, but the timing was too pure. Four runs.
Textbook straight drive! Bat high, elbow forward, the ball races away down the ground for four.
Flicked off the hips with elegance! Splinters the fielders at deep square leg and races away for four.
Carved through point! Found the gap with surgical precision, no fielder stood a chance. Four!
Punched off the front foot through mid-wicket, races away across the lightning-fast outfield for four.
Late cut played with supreme touch! Waited and guided it past the slip cordon for a boundary.
Short ball punished! Swivels effortlessly and hammers the pull to the square leg fence for four.
Driven on the up through extra cover! Beats the ring and crashes into the advertising boards for four.
Smacked flat through mid-wicket! Split the two fielders in the deep with laser accuracy. Four runs!
Opened the blade at the point of impact, slicing it wide of third man for a well-placed boundary.
Front foot forward, checked drive that simply purrs through the covers for four runs.
Swung away with enormous power! One bounce, two bounces and over the ropes at deep mid-wicket.
Sweet as you like! Punched off the back foot through the vacant offside gap for a majestic four.
Picked the bones out of that delivery! Pulled hard into the gap at deep square for a resounding four.
Slotted through mid-off with supreme authority, beating the long-off pursuer to the rope for four.

boundary_six.text: That is absolutely massive! {batter} gets hold of it and launches it high over long-on for a huge six!
In the slot and dispatched! {batter} clears the front leg and smokes it straight back over the bowler's head for a maximum.
Top edge on the hook shot! It somehow carries all the way over the fine leg boundary, six runs to the total.
Dancing down the track! {batter} meets the pitch of the ball and lifts it gracefully over the extra cover fence for a stunning six.
Power hitting at its best! {batter} muscles a short delivery deep into the stands at mid-wicket, checking to see if the ball is still in the ground!
Clean strike! {batter} picks the length early and deposits it into the second tier over long-off. That's a monster hit!
Slog sweep connected perfectly! The ball sails high into the night sky and lands deep in the crowd at square leg for six.
Upper cut over third man! {batter} uses the pace of the ball brilliantly to steer it over the ropes for a cheeky six.
Stand and deliver! {batter} doesn't even bother moving his feet, just swings hard and the ball disappears over cow corner. Maximum!
That has gone a long way! {batter} gets underneath a length ball and launches it miles over long-on. The crowd erupts!
Reverse sweep for six! {batter} switches hands and paddles it high over short third man. Incredible audacity, incredible execution.
Steps out and launches it downtown! {batter} charges {bowler}, gets to the pitch and sends it soaring over long-off for a massive six.
Flat-batted and powerful! {batter} picks up a length ball and hammers it flat over mid-wicket. Barely got any elevation but had sheer brute force.
Back foot punch over cover! {batter} leans back and lofts it with a high elbow. Beautiful, almost effortless six.
One hand off the bat and it still clears the boundary! {batter} shows his raw power with a one-handed flick over square leg for six.
Ramp shot for six! {batter} gets under the bouncer and helps it over the fine leg fence. Uses the pace of {bowler} against him.
That's been crunched! Short from {bowler} and {batter} absolutely murders the pull shot. It clears mid-wicket with yards to spare. Six!
Into the second tier! {batter} skips down the track and goes absolutely ballistic over long-on. The ball might still be going!
Flicked high and handsome! {batter} picks it off the toes and sends it sailing over deep square leg. Effortless power on display.
Picked the slower ball! {batter} reads the change of pace, waits back and heaves it over the long-on boundary. Smart hitting.
Danced down and lofted over long-on! That's six, and it never looked like coming down short.
Slog-swept flat over the midwicket rope. Six, and {bowler} has no answer.
Tossed up, and {batter} takes it on. Straight down the ground, one bounce into the crowd — no, it's carried! Six.
Picked up off the pads and deposited over deep square leg. Six.
Onto the front foot and lofted over extra cover for six. That is a beautiful cricket shot.
Cleared the front leg and swung hard. It's gone, way back over cow corner. Six.
Hooked into the night sky! Fast short ball from {bowler} sent sailing into the top deck over deep square leg for six!
Right in the slot from {bowler}! {batter} extends the arms and launches it high over long-off for a towering maximum!
Ramped over the keeper! Used {bowler}'s 140kph pace to sail clean over the third man boundary for six!
Cleared the front leg and drilled the full delivery flat over the long-on fence! Massive six!
Short ball hammered with an emphatic pull shot! Hits the roof of the stand at deep mid-wicket for six!
Pitched up on off, {batter} lofts it straight back over {bowler}'s head and into the sightscreen for six!
Slower ball spotted early! Swung wildly across the line and sent soaring 85 metres into the crowd for six!
Down the wicket to {bowler}! Smoked high, handsome, and into the grandstand for a colossal six!
Slog-sweep executed with pure brutality! {batter} gets down low and clobbers {bowler} over mid-wicket for a 95m six!
Flighted delivery tossed wide, {batter} steps across and lofts it inside-out over deep extra cover for six!
Tossed up into the hitting zone, {batter} swings effortlessly and sends it sailing over long-on for a maximum!
Switch-hit over backward point! Audacious innovation from {batter}, clearing the rope for a maximum!
Dropped short, {batter} rocks back in a flash and launches a monstrous pull into the stands for six!
High into the stratosphere! {batter} strikes it with immense power and sends it into the upper deck for six!
That has gone a mile! Cleared the ropes with ease, landing far back in the crowd for a colossal maximum!
Struck with devastating power straight down the ground! Into the second tier for an emphatic six!
Pick-up flick off the pads! Sails all the way over backward square leg for a stylish maximum!
Monster hit! Swung from the heels and deposited into the parking lot outside the ground for six!
Lofted high over long-off, carried all the way! The fielder watched it sail over his head for six.
Flat as a pancake! Struck with venom over mid-wicket, smashing into the boundary hoarding for six!
Pure timing and clean swing! Sails into the night sky and clears the deep cover boundary for six!
What a shot! Held the pose as the ball flew 90 meters over deep mid-wicket for a gigantic six!
Smoked over the bowler's head! That is outta here, into the stands for a huge maximum!
Swung away off the hips, incredible elevation and it clears the square leg fence with ease for six!
Stands tall, swings cleanly through the line and clears long-on by twenty rows! Superb six!

wicket_bowled.text: Clean bowled! {bowler} produces a peach of a delivery that beats the outside edge and crashes into the off stump.
Knocked him over! The middle stump is cartwheeling out of the ground! {batter} is completely beaten for pace.
Through the gate! A beautiful spinning delivery drifts in and turns away to rattle the timber. {batter} looks back in disbelief.
Played all around it! {batter} tries to work it to the leg side but misses completely, the ball hits the base of leg stump.
Chopped onto his own stumps! {batter} tries to cut a ball too close to the body and drags it back onto the wicket.
Yorker! Right in the blockhole and {batter} can't dig it out. The stumps are shattered, what a delivery from {bowler}!
Bowled around his legs! {batter} shuffles across and misses the flick, the ball clips leg stump on its way through. He's got to go.
Off stump out of the ground! {bowler} nips one back in from outside off, {batter} shouldered arms and paid the ultimate price.
Timber! {bowler} gets it to jag back in sharply, beats the inside edge and hits the top of off. Brilliant bowling.
Stumps everywhere! A searing yorker from {bowler} that {batter} had absolutely no answer to. All three stumps disturbed.
Gone! {bowler} tosses it up, draws {batter} forward, the ball dips and turns past the bat to hit the top of middle. Masterful spin bowling.
Dragged on! {batter} tries to drive but gets an inside edge onto the stumps. He stands there for a moment, can't believe it. Has to walk.
Through the gate! {batter} plays for the turn that isn't there and {bowler} knocks out off stump.
Bowled him! It pitched leg and hit the top of off — {batter} can only look back at the wreckage.
The arm ball does him! {batter} shoulders arms to one that skids straight on and it clatters into off stump.
Chopped on! {batter} tries to cut one that's far too close to him and drags it back into the stumps.
Beaten in the flight, stranded down the pitch, and the ball goes straight through to hit the stumps. Bowled.
Bowled him! {batter} misses a heave across the line and the middle stump is out of the ground.
Played all around it. {bowler} is through {batter}'s defence and the bails are off.
Timber! {batter} leaves a gap between bat and pad and pays for it.
Crashing yorker from {bowler}! Shatters the base of leg stump, leaving {batter} sprawling on the turf!
Nips back off the seam viciously! Slices between bat and pad, and knocks back the off-stump! Pure magic from {bowler}!
Beaten for raw pace! {bowler} hits top of off stump at 145 kph, the off bail is sent spiraling into the sky!
Inside edge dragged straight back onto the stumps! {bowler} roars in triumph as the furniture is disturbed!
Slower ball completely bamboozles {batter}! Swung far too early and the ball gently kisses middle stump!
Castled! Fast full delivery snakes through the defensive push and flattens off and middle!
Inswinging missile from {bowler}! Breaches {batter}'s defence cleanly and cartwheels the middle stump!
Late outswing draws {batter} forward, takes an inside edge onto the stumps! {bowler} strikes!
Through the gate! {bowler} tosses it up, drifts away and spins back sharply between bat and pad to rattle the stumps!
Arm ball from {bowler}! {batter} played for turn, the ball skidded on with the arm and cannoned into off stump!
Bows him around the legs! {batter} swept and missed, the ball spun out of the rough and clipped the leg stump!
Deceived in flight and dipped! {batter} lunged forward blindly, ball spun past the inside edge into off stump!
Googly strikes! {batter} failed to pick the wrong'un, played inside the line and heard the death rattle!
Pitched on middle and gripped, clipping the top of off stump! A dream dismissal for {bowler}!
Bowled him! Clean as a whistle! {batter} played all around a straight ball and the stumps are knocked back.
Timber! Total misjudgment from {batter}, left alone and the ball clipped the off stump bail!

wicket_caught.text: Up in the air... and taken safely! {batter} tries to go big but mistimes it, finding the fielder at long-off who makes no mistake.
Edged and gone! A faint tickle through to the keeper who accepts the catch with glee. {bowler} gets his man!
Straight to the fielder! {batter} drives firmly but picks out the man at cover point perfectly. A very soft dismissal in the end.
A stunning diving catch! {batter} thought he had cleared the infield but the fielder at mid-wicket pulls off a blinder to his right!
Top edge goes high into the night sky! The wicketkeeper calls for it, runs back, and takes a well-judged catch under pressure.
Caught at slip! A lovely delivery that shapes away, takes the outside edge, and carries comfortably to first slip.
Holes out to deep mid-wicket! {batter} tried to clear the fence but didn't quite get enough on it. The fielder judges it perfectly.
What a catch! Running back from mid-on, the fielder takes it over his shoulder at full stretch. {batter} can't believe it, that looked like six.
Sliced straight to backward point! {batter} threw his hands at a wide delivery and found the fielder's chest. A regulation catch in the end.
Leading edge! {batter} tries to work it to the leg side, gets a leading edge and it pops up gently to mid-off. Simple catch, big wicket.
Caught behind! That nipped away from {bowler}, took the edge and the keeper dived to his right to take a sharp chance. Great reflexes.
Toe-ends it to long-on! {batter} was looking to go big over the top but didn't get the elevation. Comfortable catch for the outfielder.
Feathered through! The slightest of edges off {batter}'s glove and the keeper snaffles it. {bowler} knew it immediately, that's a brilliant piece of bowling.
Skied it! {batter} gets under a full delivery and spoons it straight up in the air. The mid-off fielder settles under it comfortably. Dolly catch.
Juggled but held! The fielder at deep square leg gets underneath it, fumbles the first attempt but recovers brilliantly. {batter} has to depart.
Taken at slip! {batter} feels for it away from his body and the edge is snapped up low down.
Driven straight to short cover — a smart catch, and a soft dismissal for {batter}.
Skied it! The keeper circles under it and takes it comfortably. {bowler} gets his reward.
Caught at deep midwicket. {batter} didn't get hold of it and the fielder never had to move.
Edged to slip off the turn! A lovely take, low to his right. {bowler} is delighted.
Lofted straight down long-on's throat. {batter} goes for one shot too many.
Edged and taken! Flying to {fielder} at first slip who takes a sharp, tumbling catch low to the turf off {bowler}!
Faint tickle through to the keeper! {bowler} gets extra bounce outside off and the keeper pouches it gleefully!
Top edge off a hostile bouncer from {bowler}! Swirls high in the air, {fielder} calls and holds a pressure catch!
Slashed hard towards gully, {fielder} leaps sideways and pulls off a sensational one-handed stunner off {bowler}!
Leading edge off the seam! Pops up gently to cover where {fielder} takes an easy regulation catch for {bowler}.
Thick edge flies straight to {fielder} at backward point who makes no mistake! {bowler} is delighted!
Short ball pulled flat towards deep square leg! {fielder} settles on the boundary rope and takes it safely!
Slower ball mistimed completely! Skied towards mid-off where {fielder} circles and completes the catch.
Turn and bounce from {bowler}! Takes the shoulder of the bat and loops to {fielder} at slip who takes a simple catch!
Top edge on the sweep off {bowler}! Ball hangs in the afternoon sky before {fielder} settles and claims it safely.
Dances down the track and lofts {bowler} to long-on! Doesn't get all of it, {fielder} catches it two yards inside the rope!
Reverse sweep popped straight into the hands of short third man! Soft dismissal off {bowler}'s flight!
Driven hard back towards the bowler! {bowler} plucks it out of thin air on the follow-through, caught and bowled!
Flicked with the turn straight into the mid-wicket catcher's breadbasket! {fielder} makes no mistake off {bowler}.
In the air and taken! {batter} tried to go over the top, but {fielder} at long-off takes a calm, steady catch.
Bullet drive intercepted at cover! {fielder} takes a blinding reflex catch, sensational fielding!
Mistimed lofted shot towards deep mid-wicket! {fielder} runs around the boundary and pouches it cleanly.
Chipped into the infield, {fielder} charges in from mid-on and dives forward to scoop up a magnificent catch!
Sliced high into the air towards third man! {fielder} tracks it under pressure and grasps the catch with two hands.
Driven firmly but straight down the throat of {fielder} at extra cover! A gift of a wicket.

wicket_lbw.text: Huge appeal and the finger goes up! Trapped in front by {bowler}! {batter} is given out LBW, struck on the front pad plumb in front of middle.
LBW! {bowler} nips one back in from outside off, {batter} plays all around it and is hit on the back pad. Dead in front, has to go.
Rapped on the pads! {bowler} gets one to straighten from the off side and it would have hit middle and leg. The umpire has no hesitation.
Stone dead! A full delivery from {bowler} swings back in late and catches {batter} right in front of all three stumps. Easy decision for the umpire.
Pinned him! {bowler} bowls a quicker one that skids through low and hits the pad before {batter} can bring his bat down. LBW, out!
Trapped! The arm ball from {bowler} goes on straight with the angle, {batter} was expecting it to turn and is struck on the knee roll. Absolutely plumb.
That's gone! {bowler} fires one in full on middle stump, {batter} tries to flick but misses and is hit flush on the pads. The umpire raises the finger slowly.
Big shout from {bowler} and the umpire agrees! {batter} was hit on the back pad trying to work it across the line. Going on to hit leg stump, out LBW.
Huge appeal! The spinner gets one to grip and turn sharply into the pads. {batter} was playing for the turn that never came. Given out LBW!
In-swinger and it's crashing into the pads! {bowler} gets one to hoop back in and {batter} is trapped in front. That was going to demolish middle stump.
Struck on the pad and given! It pitched in line and turned back into the stumps — {batter} has to go.
The one that goes straight on! {batter} plays for the turn, is beaten on the inside, and the finger goes up.
Trapped on the crease by the arm ball. That looked plumb, and the umpire agrees.
Swept, missed, struck in front. Up goes the finger — {batter} is on his way.
Big appeal, and it's given! {batter} is caught on the crease and that was hitting middle.
Right in front of all three. There was no doubt about that one — lbw, {bowler} has his man.
Beaten by the movement and struck on the knee roll. The finger goes up and {batter} trudges off.
Searing inswinger from {bowler}! Strikes {batter} flush in front of middle stump. Umpire's finger goes straight up! LBW!
Crashing yorker thuds onto the toe! Struck plumb in front of leg stump, {bowler} appeals and the umpire nods! Out!
Nips back sharply off the seam! {batter} plays down the wrong line, struck on the knee roll right in front. LBW!
Shuffled right across the stumps! {bowler} targets middle and hits the back pad. Dead in front, given out!
Beaten by the brisk pace, late on the defensive push and struck right on the shin. Finger raised, {batter} has to walk!
Angled in from round the wicket, strikes the front pad right in line. Plumb as can be, {bowler} celebrates!
Full and swinging late, hits the back foot before {batter} can get the bat down. Huge appeal, umpire gives it out!
Arm ball from {bowler}! Skidded on straight, {batter} played for turn and was struck right on the front pad! Plumb LBW!
Pitched in line and turned just enough to hit off stump! {batter} trapped on the back foot, umpire raises the finger!
Padded away offering no shot! The ball was hitting middle and off, easiest decision of the day for the umpire! LBW!
Trapped on the sweep! Missed the sweep completely, hit right on the thigh in front of middle. That is stone dead!
Flatter delivery skids through the air, beating the defensive lunge and thudding into the shin. Given out LBW!
Beaten on the inside edge by {bowler}'s slider! Trapped right in front of the leg stump, huge shout and given!
Loud shout for LBW and the finger goes up! {batter} was trapped deep in the crease, right in line with the stumps.
Struck right on the back leg! No bat involved, dead center of the wickets. {bowler} gets his man LBW!
Played all around a straight delivery! Thudded into the front pad, umpire takes his time and raises the finger!
Huge appeal from {bowler} and the fielding side, and given! Struck in line, hitting middle stump halfway up.
LBW! Missed the flick and struck right on the knee roll. Plumb in front of middle and off, {batter} must depart.

wicket_run_out.text: Run out! Brilliant piece of fielding! A direct hit from the deep and {batter} is caught well short of the crease. The replays confirm it.
Disaster! A mix-up between the batters and there's a run out! {batter} is stranded in the middle of the pitch. Terrible running between the wickets.
Sent back and too late! {batter} set off for the single but was sent back by his partner. The throw comes in to the keeper's end and the bails are off.
Run out by a whisker! The fielder swoops in from point, underarms it to the keeper and {batter} is just short. The third umpire gives it out!
Caught short! {batter} tried to steal a second run but the throw from deep mid-wicket is flat and accurate. The stumps are broken, well short.
Suicidal running! {batter} responded to the call but there was never a single there. The fielder at mid-on lobs it to the bowler who whips the bails off.
Direct hit from the boundary! What an arm on that fielder! {batter} was trying to come back for the second and is run out by a bullet throw.
Gone! A sharp piece of work from the fielding side. The ball goes to backward point, quick pick up, rifle throw, and the stumps are down. {batter} has to go.
Lazy running and it costs a wicket! {batter} didn't ground the bat and the throw beats him to the crease. A needless dismissal.
What a throw! The fielder picks up on the run at deep cover and hits the one stump he can see from forty yards. {batter} is run out, incredible athleticism!
Terrible mix-up! {batter} is sent back, turns, and the throw beats him by a yard. Run out.
Direct hit from cover! {batter} is well short of his ground and that is brilliant fielding.
They go for a suicidal single and the keeper does the rest. Run out, and {batter} is furious with himself.
Sharp work in the deep, a flat throw to the keeper, and the bails are off. {batter} has to go.
Ball-watching, and it costs him. A quick under-arm flick and {batter} is run out.
Direct hit! {fielder} picks up cleanly at mid-wicket and shatters the stumps with a bullet throw! {batter} is gone!
Yes, no, sorry! Total breakdown in communication between the batters! {batter} is stranded halfway down the pitch!
Suicidal run! Pushed to backward point where {fielder} pounces like a panther, throws to the keeper and whips off the bails!
Bullseye from the deep! {fielder} releases a rocket from deep square leg, hitting the base of the stumps. Run out!
Sent back far too late! {batter} turns desperately and dives full length, but {fielder}'s throw beats the bat!
Non-striker backed up too far! Bowler deflects the straight drive with fingertips onto the stumps! Unlucky run out!
Disaster for {team}! Quick single called, {fielder} swoops in and throws down the bowler's stumps. Out by a yard!
Run out at the keeper's end! The throw was slightly wide, but the keeper gathers smartly and dives to break the bails!
Hesitation costs {batter} dearly! Turned back after three strides, direct hit from short cover seals the fate!
A horror mix-up! Both batters ended up at the same end, leaving {fielder} to casually flick the bails off!
Brilliant relay throw from deep fine leg! Bails removed cleanly, {batter} is short of the ground by inches!
Desperate dive, bat bounces in the air just as the bails are taken! Replays show {batter} is run out!
Fast hands from {fielder} at mid-off! Quick pick up, turn and throw down the stumps. Magnificent run out!
Run out! The throw came in flat and fast to the bowler who broke the stumps with {batter} scrambling in vain.
Self-destruction from the batting side! A non-existent single attempted, and {fielder} punishes them instantly!
Direct hit on the slide from extra cover! Unbelievable piece of fielding from {fielder}, run out!

wicket_stumped.text: Stumped! {batter} dances down the pitch but can't get to the ball. Quick as a flash, the keeper whips the bails off. Well stumped!
Out of his crease and stumped! {batter} charges down the track to {bowler} but the ball turns away. The keeper does the rest.
Beaten in the flight! {batter} comes down the pitch, the ball dips and spins past the outside edge. Lightning glovework from the keeper, stumped!
Smart bowling from {bowler}! Sees {batter} advancing, fires it wide outside off, and the keeper collects and breaks the stumps in one motion. Out, stumped!
Stumped down the leg side! {bowler} drags it down leg, {batter}'s back foot lifts for just a moment and the keeper is sharp enough to strike.
Out! {batter} dances out of his ground looking to smash it over the top, misses completely, and the keeper has the bails off before {batter} can recover.
Deceived by the slower one! {batter} is down the pitch but the ball holds its line. Left stranded, the keeper completes a tidy stumping.
Lovely piece of work all around! {bowler} flights it beautifully, {batter} is lured out of the crease, beaten on the turn, and stumped by the razor-sharp keeper.
Stumped! {batter} is drawn out of his crease and the keeper is lightning quick with the gloves.
Down the track, beaten in the air, and he can't get back. Neat work behind the stumps.
The keeper does it in a flash! {batter} overbalances for a fraction of a second and that's all it takes.
Beaten by the turn and the bounce, and {batter}'s back foot has lifted. Given — stumped.
Stumped! {batter} overbalances after playing and missing, and the keeper is up to the stumps and alert.
The keeper whips the bails off — {batter}'s back foot was just sliding out of the crease. Given.
Dragged out of his ground by the length, beaten, and stumped. Sharp glovework.
A moment's lapse and that is all it takes. {batter} is stumped, and he cannot believe it.
Gone! {batter} is out of his crease for a heartbeat and the keeper does not miss.
Stumped, and it was close — the third umpire takes a look, but the back foot was in the air.
Missed it, and the bails are off in an instant. {batter} does not even bother to look back.
Sharp, sharp glovework. {batter} loses his footing and is stumped by the width of a boot.
Stumped! {bowler} draws {batter} forward with flight, spins it past the edge and the keeper whips the bails off in a heartbeat!
Down the track and nowhere near it! Dipping delivery from {bowler}, keeper collects cleanly and takes off the bails!
Beaten by drift and turn! {batter} lunged forward, foot dragged on the paint. Lightning glovework, stumped!
Blind charge down the pitch! {bowler} spots the advance and fires it down leg, keeper gathers wide and breaks the stumps!
Out of his crease and gone! Spun past the outside edge, keeper wastes no time and dislodges the bails!
Deceived completely by the wrong'un! {batter} overbalances, the foot is outside the crease and the bails are lit up!
Slick work behind the stumps! {bowler} gets sharp bounce, keeper collects high and dislodges the bails with {batter} stranded!
Charged and beaten for spin! {batter} is three yards down the track, keeper can afford to take his time and break the stumps!
Foot on the line! Third umpire checks the side angle — no part of the foot is grounded behind the popping crease. Stumped!
Masterclass in spin bowling from {bowler}! Dip, turn, and lightning execution from the keeper. Stumped!
Stepped out to smash it into the stands, swung and missed! Bails whipped off in 0.2 seconds. Clinical stumping!
Dragged foot outside the crease on the missed sweep! Keeper whips the bails off instantly, out stumped!

dot.text: Solid forward defense from {batter}. Gets right behind the line of the ball and blocks it dead.
Beaten! A beauty of a delivery from {bowler} that moves away late past the outside edge. Close!
Driven straight to the fielder at point. Good timing but straight to the man, no run available.
Short ball ducked underneath by {batter}. Well directed bouncer but safely negotiated.
Play and a miss! {batter} attempts a loose drive away from his body and is lucky not to edge that.
Defended back down the pitch to the bowler. {bowler} fields it on his follow-through.
Leaves that one alone outside the off stump. Good judgement shown by {batter}.
Pushed to mid-on, {batter} thinks about the single but wisely stays put. Good fielding keeps it to a dot.
Good length delivery, {batter} gets behind it and blocks solidly. Keeping out the good ones.
Back of a length, not enough width to free the arms. {batter} defends watchfully on the back foot.
Appeal for LBW! Not given. Hit outside the line says the umpire. {bowler} is convinced but has to walk back.
Almost played on! The ball clips the inside edge and just misses leg stump by a coat of paint. {batter} exhales in relief.
Hit on the pads! There's an appeal but it pitched outside leg. Not out. {bowler} shakes his head and walks back.
Worked to square leg, fielder is quick off the mark and cuts off the single. Good ground fielding keeps the pressure on.
Slower ball from {bowler} and {batter} spots it early, pulls out of the shot. Just defends it back down the track.
Nothing to hit there! {bowler} lands it on a nagging length just outside off stump. {batter} wisely shoulders arms.
Swinging and missing! {batter} goes for an expansive drive but the ball wasn't there for the shot. Beaten all ends up.
Blocked with soft hands. The ball drops at his feet and dies. No run, but {batter} is seeing it nicely.
Just over the stumps! That kicked off a length from {bowler}, extra bounce surprised {batter} but went harmlessly over the bails.
Punched to cover, excellent stop diving to his left! That saves a certain boundary. Kept to a dot by brilliant fielding.
{bowler} hits the seam and it holds its line. {batter} shoulders arms and lets it through to the keeper.
Full and straight from {bowler}. {batter} smothers it under his eyes, dead bat, no run.
Banged in short, {batter} sways inside the line and lets it fly through to the keeper.
{bowler} finds the outside edge — and it falls just short of second slip! Heart in mouth stuff.
Angled across, {batter} plays for the movement that never comes. Beaten on the inside, but no damage.
Length ball on off stump, {batter} pushes it back down the ground. {bowler} stops it in his follow-through.
Nipped back in sharply and {batter} is struck on the thigh pad. Half an appeal, going down leg.
Beautiful line from {bowler}, right in the corridor. {batter} covers off stump and leaves it alone.
Big drive, big gap between bat and pad — and it misses everything. {bowler} puts his hands on his head.
Bouncer, and {batter} takes it on the shoulder. He's fine, but that one had his name on it.
{bowler} drops it into the pitch and {batter} rocks back to defend. Watchful stuff.
Wide of off and left alone. {bowler} isn't happy with that one — a touch too generous.
Tossed up by {bowler}, {batter} comes forward and smothers the spin. Bat right beside the pad.
It grips and turns past the outside edge! {batter} was nowhere near that. The keeper takes it cleanly.
{batter} uses his feet, gets to the pitch and blocks it back. Good judgement, no risk taken.
Arm ball from {bowler}, it skids on straight. {batter} jams down on it just in time.
Beaten in the flight — {batter} was through the shot early and the ball dies on him. No run.
Pad first, and up goes {bowler}! Umpire unmoved, there was an inside edge on that.
Turning out of the rough, {batter} covers the line with his front pad and lets it spin away.
Sweep attempted, and missed. It bounces off the pad and away — no run, and {bowler} liked that.
Pushed firmly into the covers, straight to the fielder. {batter} calls no, and he's right.
Punched off the back foot, but the cover fielder dives to his left and cuts it off. Excellent work.
Clipped off the pads to short midwicket. No run, and {batter} shakes his head — he wanted that one away.
Straight to mid-off. {batter} sets off, is sent back, and scrambles home. Nearly a horrible mix-up.
Firmly struck to backward point, but the fielder is right behind it. No run available.
Dropped into the leg side, the short leg fielder pounces. Nothing there.
Solid defence from {batter}. He's giving nothing away out here.
Left alone outside off. {batter} has left that beautifully all morning.
Dead bat, soft hands, the ball drops at his feet. Textbook.
Watchful from {batter}. He plays it back to {bowler} and takes a breath.
{batter} is beaten all ends up — and survives. That was far too good for him.
No run. {bowler} is building pressure here, ball after ball in the same spot.
{bowler} hits the deck hard with a vicious lifter! {batter} ducks underneath it just in time.
Steaming in from {bowler}, probing that corridor of uncertainty. Left alone outside off stump.
Beaten for sheer pace! {bowler} clocks a quick one past {batter}'s flashing blade.
Nip-backer from {bowler}! Thuds into the front pad, but high and sliding down leg. Big shout, nothing doing.
Searing yorker right at the base of the stumps! Dug out right on the crease by {batter}.
Short and hostile from {bowler}! {batter} sways out of harm's way as the keeper collects shoulder-high.
Back of a length delivery, slanting across {batter} who withdraws the bat inside the line.
Good length in the channel, shaping away late to whistle inches past the outside edge.
Slower ball out of the back of the hand! Deceives {batter} completely, but misses the off stump.
Cracking delivery from {bowler}, angling in and straightening off the seam past {batter}'s defensive push.
Tossed up enticingly by {bowler}, grips the pitch and turns sharply past the probing bat.
Flight and dip from {bowler}! {batter} leans forward to smother the spin at the pitch of the ball.
Flatter and faster through the air, skids on low. {batter} does well to jab the bat down in time.
Pitched outside leg and spun across the face of the bat towards off. Superb deception from {bowler}.
Arm ball from {bowler}! Sliding on straight with the arm, striking the pad outside the off line.
Drift in the air, bites off the deck! {batter} lunges forward with soft hands to dead-bat it into the turf.
Puffs of dust as {bowler} lands it right in the rough! Rips past the tentative forward push.
Quicker delivery on a middle stump line, worked gently into the pitch by {batter}. Dot ball.
Crisp punch through the offside by {batter}, but straight to the diving fielder at backward point.
Neat push towards mid-on, but no run available as the fielder charges in aggressively.
Defended solidly right into the pitch. {batter} looks composed and leaves no gap.
Slight miscue on the forward push, rolls harmlessly to silly mid-off. Dot ball.
Punched off the back foot towards cover, stopped cleanly on the bounce. No run.
Driven firmly towards extra cover, brilliant stop in the ring prevents any single.
Struck cleanly into the offside, but backward point intercepts with an athletic slide.
Right behind the line of the ball, bat and pad clamped together. Solid defence.
Clipped away gently towards mid-wicket, but the ring fielder cuts it off comfortably.
Pushed back down the wicket, {bowler} fields cleanly on the follow-through.
Watchfully left alone outside off stump. {batter} showing good patience here.
Dabbed into the gully region, but the fielder is quick to pounce. No run taken.

single.text: Soft hands used by {batter}, pushed gently towards mid-off and they scamper through for a quick single.
Worked away nicely with the wrists to square leg, finding the gap for an easy routine single.
Dropped at his feet and they decide to run! A direct hit would have been close, but they make it home safely.
Guided down to third man for a single. Sensible batting, rotating the strike and keeping the scoreboard ticking.
Punched off the back foot to deep cover. The fielder runs around to tidy up, keeping it down to just a single.
Inside edge onto the pad, the ball trickles away to the leg side and they pinch a cheeky single.
Driven firmly to mid-on, misfield allows them to go through! That should have been a dot ball.
Nudged off the hip to fine leg. Easy single, {batter} is rotating the strike well here.
Dabbed down to third man. Not the most glamorous shot but it does the job. One run added.
Tapped to the off side and they call quickly. Good running between the wickets converts a tight single. Well judged.
Played into the gap at mid-wicket with nice timing. Easy single, keeping the scoreboard moving along.
Defended into the covers, they think about two but settle for one. Sensible cricket, no need to take risks.
Off the pads, just wide of the fielder at short leg. They scurry through for a single, good awareness from both batters.
Steered to backward point and they set off immediately. Sharp running, the throw comes in but they're home comfortably.
Tucked off the pads to the leg side. One run. {batter} is keeping things ticking over nicely.
Pushed towards mid-off, the fielder has to run to his right and they take the single. Good placement from {batter}.
Pushed into the covers and they scamper through. {batter} is off the mark for this over.
Worked off the hip down to fine leg, comfortable single. Strike rotated.
Dropped into the on side and they run hard for one. Good, busy cricket from {batter}.
Guided down to third man, one run. {bowler} won't mind that too much.
Driven along the ground to long-off, the fielder is up quickly and it's just the single.
Turned square of the wicket, easy single, and the batters cross.
{batter} comes down the track and works it to midwicket for one. Sensible.
Nudged to short third, they take a quick single. Sharp running.
Punched off the back foot to deep point. One run and the strike changes hands.
Swept fine for a single. {batter} is starting to look for scoring options.
Pad-bat and it rolls into the leg side. They pinch a single out of very little.
Driven straight back past {bowler}, mid-on cuts it off. One to {batter}.
Steered wide of the slips and down to third man. Not from the middle, but it counts.
Worked to deep square leg, single taken, and {batter} keeps the scoreboard moving.
Fumbled in the deep and they get through for one. The fielder will hear about that.
A tickle down the leg side, keeper can't cut it off, and they cross.
Tapped into the off side and {batter} calls him through. Confident running.
Defended off the front foot into the gap at cover, and there's a single in it.
Flicked off the toes down to deep backward square. Comfortable single.
Cut hard but straight to the sweeper. Just the one run.
Pushed to mid-on and they go. A direct hit might have been interesting — it isn't.
Dabbed into the covers, they run one, and {batter} gets down to the other end.
Off the inside edge and away into the leg side for a single. Streaky, but they'll take it.
Solid push down the ground, one run, and the partnership ticks along.
Glanced fine, the fielder chases it down and keeps it to one.
Worked away square, easy single. {bowler} goes back to his mark.
Back of a length from {bowler}, {batter} rises on the toes and glides it down to third man for a single.
Tucked off the hips neatly behind square leg off {bowler}'s pace, easy single taken.
Dabbed with soft hands into the gap at backward point off the seam, they scamper through for one.
Full on the pads from {bowler}, flicked away into the deep square leg pocket for a single.
Short ball pulled rolled-wrist down to deep backward square leg, one run added.
Steered late past gully with open face off {bowler}, third man tidies up for a single.
Pushed towards mid-on against the brisk pace, sharp call and they complete a brisk run.
Tossed up by {bowler}, {batter} skips down and works it with the turn to deep mid-wicket for one.
Paddle swept fine around the corner off {bowler}, safely picked up at fine leg for a single.
Pushed through with the drift, {batter} eases it down to long-on to turn over the strike.
Driven along the carpet to wide long-off against {bowler}'s flight, comfortable single.
Played with the turn behind point, third man sweeps across to limit them to one.
Rocked back on the back foot and punched past the diving silly mid-off for a single.
Nudged softly into the leg side against the turning ball, intelligent strike rotation.
Dropped into the offside with gentle wrists, call of 'yes' and they take a sharp single.
Punched down the ground towards long-off, simple single taken to rotate the strike.
Clipped away neatly through mid-wicket, the sweeper runs in and keeps it to one.
Guidance down towards deep third, easily jogged through for a single.
Pushed wide of cover point, good communication between the batters and they cross easily.
Turned around the corner on the on-side, quick legs take them through safely.
Inside edge squirts into the vacant square leg region, they take a hurried single.
Driven along the turf to deep extra cover, sweeper sweeps up, single taken.
Tapped right into the vacant pitch area, immediate sprint and they make the crease safely.
Flicked off the toes through the mid-wicket gap, solid rotational cricket.
Steered into the gap at cover, comfortable single keeps the scoreboard ticking.
Worked wide of mid-on, alert running from {batter} secures the single.
Soft push into the covers, eye contact established, easy run completed.
Backfoot punch guided into the gap behind point, one run added to the total.
Eased down the ground to long-on, sensible batting gives the strike back to the partner.
Glanced down to fine leg with great finesse, easy run taken.

double.text: Placed into the gap at deep mid-wicket! Excellent running between the wickets, they come back for the second comfortably.
Pushed through the covers and they're running hard! The throw comes in from the deep but they make it back for two. Good cricket.
Cut away to deep point and they push for the second. The throw is slightly wide and they're home safely. Two runs.
Whipped off the pads to deep square leg! They turn quickly and come back for two. Excellent running between the wickets by both batters.
Driven to the long-off boundary! The fielder does well to cut it off but can only hold it to two. Nearly went all the way.
Pulled away to deep mid-wicket, the fielder slides to stop it near the rope. Two runs, saved a boundary there with good fielding.
Played into the gap at wide mid-on and they are quick between the wickets. Easy two, no drama involved.
Miscued towards long-on but there's enough distance to come back for two. Not off the middle of the bat but they'll take it.
Flicked off the pads and it bisects the two fielders in the deep. Comfortable two, smart batting from {batter}.
Guided to third man and they scamper back for the second! Quick call, quick running, and they beat the throw. Two valuable runs.
Driven into the gap at extra cover and they come back for the second. Well run.
Whipped off the pads into the deep, comfortably two.
Cut behind square, the sweeper cuts it off but they're back for the second.
Nicely timed through midwicket. Two runs, and {batter} is finding the middle now.
Pushed wide of mid-off and they run hard. Two, and the fielder is blowing.
Clipped off the toes, one bounce to the man in the deep. Two runs.
Half-stopped at point and they steal the second. Excellent awareness from {batter}.
Punched down the ground, long-on comes round, and they turn for two.
Mistimed into the off side, but it lands safe and there's two in it.
Worked square on the leg side, they run the first hard and stroll the second.
Beautifully placed between two fielders. Two more, and that was all timing.
Edged, but wide of the slips and away for two. Not from the middle of the bat.
Pulled away into the deep mid-wicket pocket off {bowler}'s bumper! They push hard and turn back for two.
Back of a length, punched through backward point. Third man has ground to cover, allowing a brace.
Tucked off the hips behind square, deep fine leg runs across to tidy up while they jog two.
Steered with soft hands wide of third man, excellent running between the wickets earns two.
Overpitched outside off, driven firmly between extra cover and mid-off. Held to a couple.
Short ball swiveled upon and pulled into the vacant deep square gap, comfortable two runs.
Down the track to {bowler}, chipped over mid-wicket into the outfield. They return safely for the second.
Paddle swept fine, beating the inner ring. Fine leg cuts it off on the boundary for two.
Driven against the spin through extra cover, sweeper fields and throws flat. Two runs.
Cut away late past short third man, deep backward point chases it down. Good running for two.
Pushed wide of long-on into the vast acreage of the outfield, easy brace for {batter}.
Placed with pinpoint accuracy into the gap at deep cover! Great urgency, they hustle back for two.
Flicked neatly through mid-wicket, the deep fielder swoops in but can't prevent the second.
Driven smoothly along the carpet into the deep offside, loud calling and a safe second run.
Clipped away off the pads into the vacant deep backward square area, two runs collected.
Steered through backward point, sliding save inside the rope keeps it down to a couple.
Lofted into the vacant pocket at deep extra cover, lands safe and they easily run two.
Pushed into the deep mid-wicket vacancy, alert calling from {batter} seals two more runs.
Glided fine of third man, the throw comes in to the bowler's end as they complete the second.
Whipped through mid-wicket with fast wrists, excellent boundary patrol restricts them to two.
Driven through the cover gap, good backing up prevents an overthrow as they return for two.
Punched past the extra cover fielder, long chase for the sweeper. Two runs taken cleanly.
Deflected off the open bat face down to third man, quick running produces a couple.
Worked into the deep on-side gap, {batter} turns aggressively and completes two runs.
Lofted drive over mid-off, doesn't carry to the rope. Good running between wickets earns two.

three.text: Driven to the deep and it beats the sweeper! They run three as the fielder has to chase it all the way to the fence. Held to three by a desperate dive.
Misfield in the outfield! The ball slips through the fingers and they run three while the fielder scrambles to recover. Sloppy work in the field.
Pulled away to deep mid-wicket, the fielder has a long chase! They take three, outstanding running between the wickets. {batter} is barely breathing!
Cut hard to deep backward point and they push for three! The throw is wayward and they complete the third run comfortably. Three runs.
Driven down the ground, the ball beats the fielder at long-off who has to turn and chase. They push for three and just make it. Tight!
Overthrow! The throw from the deep goes past the stumps and they get an extra run. Three in total, a bonus run from the fielding side's error.
Lofted over the infield to the deep! The fielder runs around from long-on and dives to keep it in. Three runs taken, could have been four.
Worked away through the leg side and they run hard! Three completed with a brilliant piece of running. {batter} slides his bat in just in time.
Driven wide of long-off, and they come back for the third. That's hard running.
Pulled into the deep and there's three. {batter} is in a hurry now.
Threaded through the covers, the sweeper's angle is wrong, and they run three.
Flicked into the gap at deep square, three taken. The fielders are chasing leather.
Misfield in the deep, and a comfortable two turns into three.
Straight down the ground, just pulled up short of the rope. Three runs.
Lofted over the infield and it holds up in the outfield. Three.
Cut behind square, they scamper the first two and just make the third.
Driven firmly through the covers off {bowler}! The outfield is heavy and the fielder chases it down, three runs taken.
Short ball hooked into the vast deep backward square boundary, diving save just inside the ropes restricts them to three.
Sliced past the gully off the seam, races away towards third man. Desperate slide cuts it off, three runs.
Punched off the back foot through point off {bowler}, deep sweeper slides and parries back. They run three hard.
Full toss driven past mid-on, long boundary requires a sliding stop. Three brilliant runs on the board.
Lofted inside-out over cover against {bowler}'s spin! Doesn't quite reach the rope, sweeper recovers to keep it to three.
Swept powerfully towards deep square leg! Outfielder runs around the boundary and flicks it back in, three runs.
Cut fiercely through backward point off {bowler}, long chase towards the boundary fence. Three hard runs.
Dancing down the track, chipped wide of long-on. Massive ground to cover for the fielder, three taken.
Flayed through extra cover! Tremendous effort from the boundary rider to flick it back. Batters run three.
Whipped off the pads into the deep mid-wicket acreage! The batters sprint hard and turn for the third comfortably.
Guided exquisitely into the vacant pocket between third man and cover, great teamwork to run three.
Driven beautifully down the ground, deep fielder puts in a diving effort at the boundary edge to save one run. Three runs.
Punched past mid-off with superb timing, the fielder chases all the way to the boundary cushions to pull it back. Three taken.
Pulled deep towards square leg, superb slide and relay throw holds the damage to three runs.
Edged but flies wide of slip down towards the third man fence, sweeping fielder retrieves. Three runs.
Cracking stroke through the offside, beats the inner ring. Outfield slows it down, batters take three.
Lofted into the deep gap, outfield fielder dives headfirst to keep the ball in play. Three hard-fought runs.
Clipped away into the expansive mid-wicket outfield, great running between the wickets yields three.
Driven wide of long-off, sweeper has to sprint 30 yards to cut it off. Excellent running makes it three.

wide.text: Wayward line down the leg side, the umpire stretches his arms. Wide called.
Too wide outside off stump, chasing the tramlines. Umpire calls it a wide, free run.
Bouncer goes way over the head of {batter}! The square leg umpire signals a wide for height.
Slipping down the leg side again! {bowler} is struggling with his line here. Wide signalled, the captain won't be pleased.
That's gone miles down the leg side! Even the keeper struggled to collect it. Wide called, sloppy delivery.
Sprayed well outside off stump. {batter} left it alone and the umpire extends both arms. Wide, and rightly so.
Wide! The slower ball from {bowler} drifts too far down the leg side. Bonus run for the batting side.
That's a wide! Trying the bouncer but it's too high and too wide. Umpire has no hesitation in signalling.
Sprayed down the leg side and the umpire's arms go out. Wide.
Well outside off and left alone — that's called. One extra.
{bowler} loses his line completely there. Wide, and he knows it.
Too far across {batter} and the umpire is quick to signal. Wide called.
Down leg, the keeper does well to stop it, but it's still a wide.
Drifting way down the leg side. Wide, and a free run for {team}.
Wayward line down the leg side from {bowler}, well past the tramlines. Umpire signals wide.
Attempted wide yorker from {bowler} slips too far outside off stump, called wide by the umpire.
Fired down leg as {batter} shuffles across, beat the pads and keeper. Signaled wide.
Way too short! Bouncer from {bowler} sails harmlessly over {batter}'s helmet, called wide for height.
Spilled well outside off stump, chasing the tramlines. Free run gifted to {team}.
Straying down leg, keeper dives to prevent further damage. Wide called by the umpire.
Slips out of {bowler}'s hand wet with sweat, way down the leg side for a wide.
Attempted slower bouncer goes astray, sails way above head height. Umpire calls wide.
Wild delivery wide outside off, {batter} watches it sail into the keeper's gloves. Wide called.
Spun viciously out of the rough down the leg side, beat everyone. Wide signalled.
Way down leg from around the wicket, poor execution from {bowler}. Wide.
Tried to keep it away from the batter's arc, but breached the off-side wide guideline. Free run.
Strays onto the pads and down leg, umpire extends both arms. Wide delivery.
Bouncer flies well over {batter}'s head, umpire signals wide for excessive height.
Loose delivery miles outside the off stump, easy call for the umpire. Wide.

noball.text: Huge shout for a wicket but the umpire signals No Ball! {bowler} has overstepped the line considerably.
It's a No Ball for height! That full toss was dangerously high above the waist. Free hit coming up!
No Ball! {bowler} has overstepped the crease. A free run and a free hit on the way for the batting side. Pressure on the bowler.
Front foot no ball! {bowler} was right on the line and the third umpire confirms his front foot has landed beyond the crease. Free hit next ball!
No ball called! {bowler} trying too hard for extra pace and has overstepped in the process. Gift for the batting side.
That's a no ball for height! Full toss above waist height, that could have been dangerous. Free hit coming up, {batter} will be licking his lips.
Over the line! The umpire calls no-ball, and {bowler} has to bowl that one again.
No-ball for overstepping. That's an extra plus a free hit to come.
Way over waist height on the full — called immediately. No-ball.
{bowler} drags his foot through and it's a no-ball. Careless.
A second bouncer in the over and the umpire signals no-ball.
Called for overstepping again. {bowler} needs to sort his run-up out.
Overstepping from {bowler}! Massive front-foot no-ball called. Free hit coming up for {batter}!
Dangerous beamer! Waist-high full toss from {bowler}, umpire calls No Ball immediately!
Sirens wail as the third umpire spots the overstep! No ball called, extra run and a free hit!
Back foot sliced past the return crease! Umpire signals No Ball, discipline letting {bowler} down.
High full toss slipping above the waistline! Batter pulls it away, umpire signals No Ball!
No Ball! {bowler} crosses the line by inches. Free hit opportunity awaits the batting side!
Wicket taken but wait — the umpire has his arm outstretched! No ball! Heartbreak for {bowler}!
Front foot landed well beyond the popping crease, clear No Ball signaled. Free hit coming!
Above waist height full toss! Called No Ball by square leg umpire, bowler apologizes immediately.
Big overstep from {bowler}! Free hit to follow, {team} will look to make this count!
Overstepped on the front foot, the umpire calls No Ball. A free gift for {batter}!
Dangerous delivery above the waist, called No Ball instantly! Free hit signaled.
No Ball signaled! Bowler oversteps by half a shoe, {fielding_team} will rue that lapse in discipline.
Sirens in the stadium! Front foot lands outside the crease, no ball called. Free hit coming up.
Overstepping from {bowler}, hands a free run and a free hit to the batting side.

byes.text: Past the keeper! The ball beats everyone including the wicketkeeper, byes signalled. Runs added to the extras column.
Byes! That took an awkward bounce and beat the keeper who dives in vain. The batters run through for byes.
Through to the keeper... oh, he's fumbled it! The batters are alert and steal a run. Byes conceded.
The ball clips the top of off stump but somehow the bail stays on! It deflects past the keeper and they run through. Byes.
Past the keeper and away — they run {runs}. Byes, and {bowler} isn't happy about it.
It beats {batter} and it beats the keeper too. {runs} bye(s) added.
Down the leg side, the keeper can't gather cleanly, and they scamper through for byes.
Bounced over the keeper's head. They run {runs} byes, and the fielding side look sloppy.
A rare miss from the gloves and the batters take advantage. Byes.
Through to the keeper — no, he's dropped it, and they take a bye.
Extra bounce off the deck! Beats the swinging bat and sails over the leaping wicketkeeper for byes!
Ripping turn out of the footmarks! Beats both batter and keeper, allowing byes to be taken.
Past everyone! Sharp seam movement eludes {batter}'s edge and evades the diving keeper. Byes.
Bouncing lifter flies over the batter's shoulder, keeper can only get fingertips to it. Byes run.
Beats the outside edge and dips in front of the keeper, bobbles through for a bye.
Turn and bite off the wicket! Keeper blinded by the batsman, ball rolls to third man for byes.
Wild bounce eludes the wicketkeeper's outstretched gloves, batters scamper through for byes.
Swinging late, beats the bat and slips through the keeper's legs. Byes signaled by umpire.
Tricky bounce keeps low, nutmegs the keeper and runs away down to fine leg for byes.
Ball sails past the off stump and deceives the keeper with wicked swing. Byes added.
Drifting past the outside edge, keeper fumbles the collection and they steal a bye.
High bounce over the stumps, keeper jumps but can't reach it. Runs credited to byes.
Beats bat and keeper down the leg side, fielders chase as byes are taken.
Sharp skidder under the bat, keeper fails to gather cleanly. Batters run through for byes.
Beats everything! Neither batter nor keeper could lay a glove on that. Byes signaled.

legbyes.text: Off the pads and away to the leg side! Leg byes signalled by the umpire. The batters take the run.
Struck on the pad, no shot offered but the ball runs away to fine leg. Leg bye taken, the umpire signals accordingly.
Hits the thigh pad and deflects to square leg. The batters run through for leg byes. {bowler} is frustrated, beating the bat but not getting rewarded.
Off the hip and it rolls towards fine leg. Leg bye signalled. Not off the bat, but the batters take advantage and run through.
Off the pad and into the leg side. They take {runs} leg bye(s).
Struck on the thigh pad and it rolls away square. Easy leg byes.
Off the hip, fine of the keeper, and they run. Leg byes signalled.
It hits the pad and dribbles to short leg's left. They steal a leg bye.
Off the boot and away behind square. {runs} leg bye(s) to the total.
Missed the sweep entirely, but it's off the pad and away for leg byes.
Struck on the thigh pad off {bowler}'s fast delivery, deflects wide of the slips for leg byes.
Off the front pad and rolls into the on-side, batters hustle across for a quick leg bye.
Attempted flick misses the blade, thuds into the pad and squirts towards fine leg. Leg bye signaled.
Angling into the pads from around the wicket, deflects towards backward square leg for a leg bye.
Struck on the ribs by a sharp lifter from {bowler}, rolls into the vacant offside as they cross.
Turn and bounce into the midriff, deflects fine and they run an easy leg bye.
Missed the sweep, ball brushes the back pad and trickles past the keeper for a leg bye.
Thuds against the knee roll, huge shout for LBW turned down, batters scamper for a leg bye.
Deflected off the pad fine down to third man, comfortable leg bye taken by {batter}.
Shuffled across the stumps, struck on the pad outside leg. Umpire signals leg bye.
Full ball hits the boot and ricochets towards cover point. Alert running brings a leg bye.
Brushed the back hip off a bouncer, rolls to the leg side. Leg bye signaled.
Off the pads into the offside, quick sprint across the pitch for a leg bye.
Inswinger thuds onto the front pad, loud appeal denied, batters complete the leg bye safely.
Deflected off the thigh pad into the deep, batters jog through for a couple of leg byes.

free_hit.text: Free hit! {batter} swings hard and connects! But it's straight to the fielder in the deep. Can't be out though, it's a free hit. Dot ball.
Free hit delivery and {batter} launches it! It sails over the boundary for six! Making the most of the free hit opportunity!
Free hit and {batter} crunches it through the covers for four! That's the way to capitalize on a no-ball. Free runs!
Free hit but {batter} can't take advantage. Swings and misses, the ball goes through to the keeper. A reprieve wasted.
Free hit coming up — {batter} can only be run out here.
Field spreads for the free hit. {batter} is licking his lips.
A free hit to follow. {fielding_team} will be desperate to keep this one quiet.
{batter} has a free swing at this one. Anything can happen.
Free hit delivery! {batter} swings from the heels but only manages an inside edge onto the pad. Dot ball!
Free hit! {batter} lofts it high in the air, caught at long-on! But the batter smiles and stays — free hit means not out!
Free hit delivery sliced into the outfield, deep cover sweeps up and limits {batter} to just a single.
Yorker nailed by {bowler} on the free hit! {batter} digs it out on the crease, brilliant execution under pressure!
Slower ball on the free hit! {batter} swings far too early, beaten all ends up. Dot ball!
Free hit hammered through extra cover! Sweeper dives to prevent the boundary, batters take two.
Bowled him on the free hit! Stumps clattered, but {batter} survives because it was a free hit! Dot ball!
Free hit! Full toss drilled down to long-off for a single. Good recovery from {bowler}.
High in the air on the free hit! Lands safely in no man's land at deep mid-wicket, batters take two.
Wide yorker on the free hit! {batter} reaches out but can't connect. Excellent death bowling!
Free hit swung violently across the line, top edge lands harmlessly on the turf for a single.
Slower bouncer on the free hit, {batter} misses with the pull. Golden opportunity wasted!
Free hit driven firmly straight to mid-off, no run available! Exceptional bowling from {bowler}.
Banged in short on the free hit, {batter} ducks underneath it. A wasted free hit.
Free hit crunched down the ground, deep long-on cuts it off to hold them to a single.

wicket_hit_wicket.text: Hit wicket! {batter} loses his balance and treads back onto his own stumps. A dreadful way to go.
Oh dear — {batter} ducks a short one and the bat clips the bails on the way down. Hit wicket.
He's kicked the stumps! {batter} is out hit wicket, and he cannot believe what he has just done.
The helmet, the bat, or the boot — something took the bails off. {batter} is out hit wicket.
Hit wicket. {batter} rocks back to pull, overbalances, and dislodges a bail. {bowler} will take it.
A tangle of pads and bat, and the leg bail is on the floor. Hit wicket, and that is a sad end.
Deceived by the pace and stumbling backwards, {batter} sits down on his own stumps. Hit wicket.
Given hit wicket. {batter} caught his heel in the crease and the bails paid the price.
Hit wicket! {batter} goes deep into the crease to play the cut and clips the off bail with his shoe!
Oh disaster! {batter} swivels on the pull, loses balance and tumbles backward straight onto the stumps! Hit wicket!
Ducking underneath a short ball, the bat slips in the hands and drops down onto the bails! Bizarre hit wicket dismissal!
Deep in the crease, heel knocks the leg stump bail off as {batter} plays the backfoot punch. Hit wicket!
Follow-through of the bat strikes the stumps! {batter} looks back in pure disbelief as the bail falls to the turf.
Unbelievable scenes! {batter} treads on his own stumps while adjusting his footing! An unfortunate way to go.
Hit wicket! Backed away to make room outside leg, clipped the leg stump with the heel. Extraordinary dismissal!
Swept from deep in the crease, the toe of the bat dislodged the off bail on the backswing. Out hit wicket!
Stumbles on the turn and the back foot dislodges the bail. A freak dismissal, hit wicket!
Hit wicket! Tried to squeeze out a yorker deep in the crease and the bat rebounded onto the stumps!
Bat slipped on the follow-through and dislodged both bails. {batter} has to walk off shaking his head.
Stepped back to flick into the leg side, boot nudged the middle stump. Bails light up, hit wicket!
Tragic way to get out! {batter} arches back against a bouncer and clips the stumps with his helmet strap!
Loses footing in the crease, slips onto the off stump! Hit wicket called, what a bizarre moment in this match.

dropped_catch.text: DROPPED! An absolute sitter shelled by {fielder}! Put down on a plate and grassed, {bowler} cannot believe it!
DROPPED! Edged to first slip! {fielder} dives to the right, gets two hands to it but spills the chance!
DROPPED! High swirling skier in the wind! {fielder} calls for it, settles underneath, but the ball pops in and out of the hands!
DROPPED! Slog into the deep towards mid-wicket! {fielder} sprints in, slides forward, but shells the catch!
DROPPED! Slashed hard to backward point! Flew at chest height, {fielder} reacts late and drops it!
DROPPED! Faint edge through to the keeper! Keeper dives low to his left but fumbles the take, a huge let-off for {batter}!
DROPPED! Driven firmly back to {bowler}! Hand out on the follow-through, touches it but can't hang on!
DROPPED! Difficult diving effort by {fielder} at extra cover! Full-length dive, fingertips to the ball, but it spills onto the turf.
DROPPED! Leading edge loops up towards mid-on, {fielder} backpedals frantically but can't complete the catch!
DROPPED! Sliced high in the air towards third man! Fielder over-runs the ball and drops a golden chance!
DROPPED! Thick outside edge between slip and gully, second slip dives across first slip and parries it to the turf!
DROPPED! Pulled flat to deep square leg, hits {fielder} right in the breadbasket and bounces out! Costly miss!
DROPPED! Spun past the forward defence, edge lands into the keeper's gloves and pops out! {bowler} holds his head in despair.
DROPPED! What an agonizing miss! Sitter at cover point, spilled cold by {fielder}. {batter} gets a second life!
DROPPED! Hook shot flies to deep backward square leg, {fielder} parries the ball over the turf, chance goes begging!
DROPPED! Down the track, chipped towards mid-off! {fielder} dives forward, scoops it up but loses control on impact with the turf.
DROPPED! Reaching out on the drive, outside edge flies at waist height to second slip who shells it! Disbelief in the dugout!
DROPPED! Skied high towards long-on! Two fielders converge, neither calls early, and the ball falls between them untouched!
DROPPED! Reverse sweep hits {fielder} at short third man on the chest and hits the ground! A massive reprieve!
DROPPED! Slower ball chipped straight back to {bowler}, who grasses the return catch! Unbelievable miss!

misfield.text: MISFIELD! Routine ground ball bobbles through the hands of {fielder} in the ring, allowing an extra run!
MISFIELD! Pushed to cover, {fielder} slips on the turn and the batters steal a bonus run!
MISFIELD! Driven to deep mid-off, {fielder} misjudges the spin and fumbles, gifting an unnecessary extra run!
MISFIELD! Ball nutmegs {fielder} on the boundary line, allowing the batters to hustle through for an additional run!
MISFIELD! Sloppy work in the inner ring from {fielder}, fails to gather cleanly and concedes a run!
MISFIELD! Tapped towards point, fielder overruns the ball and {team} pinches an extra single!
MISFIELD! Fumbled by {fielder} at mid-wicket, the captain shakes his head as the batters complete the run.
MISFIELD! Sliding pickup on the boundary fumbled by {fielder}, turning a single into two easy runs!
MISFIELD! Defended gently, but {fielder} fumbles on the pickup and invites the quick run!
MISFIELD! Wild throw from the deep misses the stumps, no backing up and they steal an extra overthrow!
MISFIELD! Ball skids under {fielder}'s body at extra cover, lazy fielding costs a run!
MISFIELD! Routine pickup botched by {fielder} at backward point, batters scamper through with a smile.
MISFIELD! Fumbled at mid-on, pressure from the batters' aggressive calling forces the error!
MISFIELD! Ball bounces awkwardly over {fielder}'s shoulder on the boundary, gift run conceded!
MISFIELD! Hesitation and a soft fumble from {fielder} at short fine leg allows an easy single.
MISFIELD! Direct hit attempt from {fielder} flies wide, backup fumbles and they pinch another run!
MISFIELD! Steered to third man, fielder slips on the damp outfield giving away an extra run!
MISFIELD! Infield fumble at mid-off, {fielding_team} looking sloppy in the field today.
MISFIELD! Ball slips through {fielder}'s fingers on the scoop, extra run gifted away.
MISFIELD! Routine stop fumbled at square leg, the batters didn't hesitate and crossed for an extra run!

collapse_wicket: Another one bites the dust! {team} are falling apart here. The dug-out looks extremely worried.
The procession continues! Batsmen are coming and going like a revolving door. {team} in deep trouble.
Absolute disaster for {team}! They are losing wickets in clumps and the innings is unraveling fast.
Panic stations now! A collapse is unfolding right before our eyes. Someone needs to anchor this innings.
Wickets tumbling here! {team} are in a complete mess, and the body language in the dugout says it all.
The wheels are coming off for {team}! They simply cannot stem the bleeding here. This is turning into a rout.
high_pressure_dot: Swing and a miss! Nerves of steel from {bowler}. The crowd is on the edge of their seats!
The pressure is mounting with every dot ball! The required rate is climbing and the tension is palpable.
You can hear a pin drop in the stadium! The tension is unbearable as another ball passes without a run.
Gold dust! A dot ball at this stage is massive for the fielding side. The batter looks frustrated.
Dot ball! The equation is getting tougher by the delivery. The asking rate is spiralling out of control.
Can't find the boundary! {batter} is struggling to get it off the square. The pressure is immense.
partnership_50: That's the 50 partnership! These two are rebuilding the innings nicely and looking comfortable in the middle.
A solid stand developing here. 50 runs added between these two, bringing some stability back to the innings.
Frustration growing for {fielding_team} as this partnership crosses the 50-run mark. They need a breakthrough.
Fifty-run partnership! These two have batted intelligently and rotated the strike brilliantly. Good foundation being laid.
Half-century stand! A really important partnership in the context of this match. Both batters looking settled.
milestone_50: Fifty for {batter}! A well-compiled innings under pressure. Raises the bat to acknowledge the applause.
He raises his bat to the crowd! A fighting half-century from {batter}, playing a crucial role for his team.
Great knock! {batter} reaches his fifty with style. He has looked in fine touch since ball one.
Fifty up for {batter}! He punches the air and acknowledges the dressing room. What an innings this has been.
Half-century! {batter} gets to the milestone and the crowd rises to applaud. A measured innings of real quality.
milestone_100: HUNDRED! What a magnificent innings from {batter}! He takes off his helmet and soaks in the applause.
Take a bow, {batter}! A century to remember. This has been a masterclass in batting.
Ton up! {batter} reaches the magical three figures. A truly special performance on the big stage.
CENTURY! The crowd goes absolutely wild! {batter} leaps in the air, what an extraordinary knock this has been!
A hundred runs! {batter} raises his bat, kisses the badge on his helmet. This innings will be talked about for years.
expensive_over: Expensive over! The momentum is shifting back to the batting side. {bowler} will be disappointed with that effort.
Runs leaking now! {bowler} is under the pump as the batters capitalize on some loose deliveries.
Big over for the batting side! This could be the turning point of the match.
Runs flowing freely! The batters are cashing in and the bowling side is under serious pressure now.
That's gone for plenty! {bowler} has been taken to the cleaners in that over. The captain needs to think quickly.
maiden_over: Six dots in a row! A magnificent maiden over from {bowler} keeps the pressure firmly on.
Brilliant bowling! Completely tied down the batter for six balls. A maiden over is gold dust in this format.
Maiden! Just what the doctor ordered. {bowler} hitting the right areas consistently.
A rare maiden over in T20 cricket! {bowler} has been outstanding, not giving an inch to the batters.
Six balls, zero runs! {bowler} takes a moment to appreciate that. Exceptional discipline and control.
last_over_drama: It all comes down to this! Final over, nerves jangling on both sides. This is what cricket is all about!
Last over! The crowd is on their feet, every delivery could decide the match. Incredible scenes here!
Six balls to decide this contest! The tension is thick, you can feel it right through the television screen.
close_finish: What a finish! This match has gone right down to the wire. Edge-of-the-seat stuff!
Nailbiting finish! Both teams gave everything out there. That's why we love this game!
It couldn't have been any closer! Heart rates through the roof in both camps.
Nerves of steel required now! The stadium is electric as we enter the defining moments of this thriller!
Every single run is like gold dust now! Heart rates through the roof in both dressing rooms!
It comes down to this! One good shot or one magical ball will decide the contest right here!
Absolute scenes in the stadium! Down to the absolute wire, you cannot script drama like this!
Tension you can cut with a knife! Both sets of players are on absolute edge as the finish line looms!
big_over: That over has changed the complexion of this match! The batting side has seized the momentum.
A massive over! The required rate has dropped significantly. The pressure is shifting back onto the bowlers.
What an over that was! The batting side has broken free and the runs are flowing.
death_overs: Into the death overs now! This is where reputations are made and matches are won.
