The business end of the innings is here. Every ball counts from here on in.
Slog overs! The batters will be looking to tee off and maximize every delivery.
powerplay: Powerplay is on! Only two fielders allowed outside the circle. The batters will be looking to capitalize.
Inside the powerplay, fielding restrictions in play. This is where the batting side needs to set the platform.
Powerplay cricket! Aggressive fields, attacking bowling, this is the most exciting phase of the game.
fc_new_ball: The second new ball is taken, and {bowler} has it in his hand. This is the passage that decides sessions.
A brand new cherry! The lacquer's on, the seam is proud, and suddenly the batters have a whole new problem.
New ball, new spell, new danger. {fielding_team} have been waiting eighty overs for this.
The cherry is shining red and the slip cordon is packed! Second new ball taken, watch out!
Eighty overs bowled, and {bowler} takes the brand-new ball. This next hour will decide the match.
Fresh lacquer, hard seam! The new ball is in {bowler}'s hands, danger lurks on every ball.
fc_lead_taken: And that's the lead! {team} nose in front for the first time in the match.
Past the opposition's total — every run from here is a run of advantage for {team}.
The deficit is wiped out. {team} are ahead, and the whole complexion of the match has shifted.
fc_last_hour: Into the last hour, and the batters' only job now is to still be there at stumps.
The shadows are long and the field is up. Survive this and they come back fresh in the morning.
Close of play approaching — nobody wants to be the man who gets out with ten minutes left.
The shadows lengthen across the turf as the final hour begins. Pure survival mode now.
Last hour of play! The fielding side has a ring of catchers waiting for any lapse in focus.
Testing times in the final hour! Wickets here would completely tip the balance overnight.
fc_pitch_wearing: The pitch is starting to talk. {bowler} is getting real purchase out of the rough now.
Puffs of dust off a length. This surface is breaking up, and batting last on it will be no fun at all.
Turning square. {bowler} barely has to do anything — the pitch is doing it for him.
The cracks are widening on this surface! {bowler} getting dramatic puff and unpredictable bounce.
Day by day this pitch deteriorates, and right now {bowler} is making the ball do unbelievable things.
Footmarks being targeted consistently now by {bowler}. Every ball has an answer to find.
fc_maiden_sequence: Another maiden! {bowler} has the batters in a vice — nothing on offer, nowhere to go.
Maiden after maiden. The scoreboard hasn't moved in an age and the pressure is becoming unbearable.
Relentless from {bowler}. Dot after dot after dot — this is first-class bowling at its most suffocating.
fc_milestone_150: A hundred and fifty! {batter} has made this innings his own and shows no sign of giving it up.
150 for {batter} — this has stopped being an innings and started being an occupation.
The big one. {batter} brings up 150 and {fielding_team} look utterly out of ideas.
A commanding 150 for {batter}! Showing absolute mastery over both pace and spin.
150 on the board! {batter} continues to punish {fielding_team} with relentless class.
Sensational batsmanship! {batter} crosses 150, converting a great knock into a match-winning marathon.
fc_partnership_100: The century stand! These two have taken the game away from {fielding_team}.
A hundred added together — patient, watchful, and utterly demoralising for the bowling side.
100 for the partnership. This is the passage of play that breaks an attack's back.
A century partnership! These two have formed an impenetrable wall for {team}.
100-run stand! Patient, mature, and clinical cricket from this batting pair.
The century stand is up! They have completely changed the momentum of this match.
fc_nightwatchman: And it's the nightwatchman! {batter} is sent up the order to see out the day.
A bowler walks out with the light fading — the nightwatchman's thankless job begins.
{batter} promoted to protect a specialist. Block, leave, survive: that's the entire brief.
fc_follow_on_saved: The follow-on is saved! {team} will get to bat again in their own time.
Past the follow-on mark — a huge moment, and you can see the relief in the middle.
A huge collective sigh of relief from the {team} dressing room as the follow-on is officially averted!
Safety first! {team} pass the follow-on target and ensure they will dictate their second innings on their own terms.
Crucial milestone achieved! Avoiding the follow-on keeps {team} firmly in this contest.
Resilient batting from {team}! The follow-on threat is eradicated with grit and discipline.
bowler_3fer: That's three wickets in the innings for {bowler}! A superb exhibition of bowling control.
Three in the bag for {bowler}! He has completely ripped through the opposition lineup today.
A three-wicket haul for {bowler}! Every spell has brought danger for the batters.
Spellbinding from {bowler}! Claims his third scalp and leaves {team} reeling.
{bowler} is on fire! Three crucial breakthroughs to put {fielding_team} in complete command.
Three wickets for {bowler}! A tireless and disciplined bowling performance.
bowler_5fer: FIVE WICKET HAUL! Raise the ball to the crowd, {bowler}! An unforgettable masterclass of bowling!
A glorious fifer for {bowler}! That is what greatness looks like on the big stage!
Five wickets in the innings! {bowler} has dismantled {team} single-handedly today!
Take a bow, {bowler}! Five wickets in a match-defining, sensational spell of cricket!
Five for {bowler}! He kisses the badge and leads the team off to a standing ovation!
Devastating bowling! {bowler} bags his fifth wicket of the innings, an elite performance!
fc_milestone_200: DOUBLE HUNDRED! A monumental innings of supreme endurance from {batter}! An absolute marathon at the crease!
Two hundred runs! Take your helmet off and soak it in, {batter}! A historic double century to remember for generations!
200 for {batter}! Flawless concentration and unflinching discipline over hours of batting excellence.
Double century! A masterclass in batsmanship from {batter}. The entire ground rises to applaud this genius knock.
